availableCommands.description: Debug your current Claude Code session by reading the session debug log. (bundled)
availableCommands.name: debug

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.
availableCommands.name: do

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.
availableCommands.name: knowledge-agent

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.
availableCommands.name: make-plan

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.
availableCommands.name: mem-search

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.
availableCommands.name: pathfinder

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.
availableCommands.name: smart-explore

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.
availableCommands.name: timeline-report

availableCommands.description: (claude-mem) Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, npm publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves), build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation.
availableCommands.name: claude-code-plugin-release

availableCommands.description: Clear conversation history but keep a summary in context. Optional: /compact [instructions for summarization]
availableCommands.name: compact

availableCommands.description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
availableCommands.name: init

availableCommands.description: Get comments from a GitHub pull request
availableCommands.name: pr-comments

availableCommands.description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch
availableCommands.name: security-review
